name: Gästehaus Elfriede
beschreibung:
Set in a scenic location in Gerlos, Gaestehaus Elfriede welcomes hikers and winter sports enthusiasts with cordial hospitality. Clean, comfortable rooms ensure a restful stay in the Alps.

The mountain lifts of the Zillertal Arena, scenic winter paths, and cross-country tracks are easily accessible.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Elfriede in Gerlos offers comfortable guestrooms in the heart of the Zillertal Arena.
